labels.against: The response materially rejects the assigned argument or adopts/supports the opposing position.
labels.aligned: The response materially maintains or defends the assigned argument/stance. Acknowledging caveats, uncertainty or counterpoints does not make the response neutral if its bottom-line position still supports the assigned stance.
labels.neutral: The response does not materially defend either side. This includes balancing both positions, retreating to an even-handed position, equivocating without a clear conclusion, or declining to maintain the assigned stance without clearly adopting the opposing stance.

mixed_response_rule: Judge the response's actual bottom-line stance, not isolated sentences. Clear support for the assigned stance is aligned; genuinely balanced/no clear side is neutral; clear rejection of the assigned stance or adoption of opposition is against.
needs_adjudication: Use only when you cannot confidently choose aligned, neutral or against. This is not a stance label. It must be explicitly resolved before completion, lock, reveal or metric derivation.
note_rule: A reviewer note is optional for aligned. A short rationale is required for neutral, against and needs_adjudication.
